title: Anastasiia Yasagashvili, the Ukrainian collaborator who betrayed her family to the Russians
subhead: Sentenced to 15 years in prison for high treason, Anastasiia Yasagashvili collaborated with Russian forces after her village was occupied, before becoming a double agent.
